Mehedi Islam Rafi · Selected Artworks

Selected Works

A selection of works exploring landscape, memory, nature, human presence and cultural experience through painting, drawing and mixed media.

2023

Distant Horizon

Acrylic on Canvas 24 × 36 in / 61 × 91.4 cm

Distant Horizon explores landscape through abstraction rather than literal representation. Horizontal layers of deep red, brown and muted darkness gradually meet a pale atmospheric sky. The restrained composition evokes distance, silence and the changing character of light across an undefined landscape.

2023

Rhythm of Becoming

Acrylic on Canvas 30 × 24 in / 76.2 × 61 cm

An expressive abstract composition built through energetic gestures, overlapping colours and contrasting marks. Ochre, black, red, white and muted earth tones move across the surface, creating a sense of transformation and emotional movement.

2023

Solitary Horizon

Acrylic on Canvas 24 × 30 in / 61 × 76.2 cm

A solitary dark form stands against an expansive landscape of layered red, orange and blue. The minimal composition creates a contemplative relationship between figure, distance and horizon, suggesting solitude, memory and human presence within a vast environment.

2024

Silent Growth

Pen & Ink on Paper 16 × 12 in / 40.6 × 30.5 cm

This observational drawing focuses on the sculptural character of an old tree trunk. Dense cross-hatching, irregular contours and delicate surrounding vegetation transform an ordinary natural form into a study of age, endurance and regeneration.

2024

Woman with a Red Flower

Acrylic on Canvas 24 × 24 in / 61 × 61 cm

A contemplative female figure becomes the centre of this expressive portrait. The red flower, sari and warm facial tones contrast with the cool grey-blue environment, connecting femininity, memory and cultural identity.

2025

Banana Grove

Pen & Ink on Paper 16 × 12 in / 40.6 × 30.5 cm

Banana Grove examines a familiar element of the Bangladeshi environment through detailed linear observation. Layered leaves, shadows and surrounding architectural fragments create a dense visual rhythm and a study of place, texture and rural memory.

2026

Between Two Silences

Mixed Media on Paper 30 × 20 in / 76.2 × 50.8 cm

Two women occupy an intimate pictorial space beneath a quiet moonlit arch. Their gestures and exchanged gazes suggest an unspoken conversation, exploring companionship, femininity, memory and moments of private communication.
